items.q: How much is the room rate per night?
items.a: Room rates start from IDR 200,000/night for Single Bed and IDR 250,000/night for Double Bed. Includes AC, WiFi, 32" Android TV, and amenities.
Each room has AC, 32" Android TV, free WiFi, en-suite shower bathroom, spring bed + goose pillows, cotton linen, fresh towels daily, and soundproof walls.
Yes, all areas of Wisma Apollo have free WiFi with adequate speed for streaming and working.

items.q: How do I make a reservation?
items.a: Reservations can be made via WhatsApp at 0818 232 021. Just send your name and desired stay dates. We will reply quickly.
Yes, breakfast is available by request for an additional IDR 20,000 per person. Contact the receptionist to order.
Yes, extra beds and pillows are available for an additional IDR 50,000 per room. Please inform us during reservation.
Check-in from 14:00 and check-out by 12:00. Early check-in or late check-out can be arranged based on availability.

sections.heading: Why Wisma Apollo is the Preferred Hotel in Kuala Kurun?
paragraphs: If you have ever visited Kuala Kurun, the capital of Gunung Mas Regency in Central Kalimantan, you know that hotel options here are not as abundant as in larger cities. That is precisely where Wisma Apollo steps in as the solution.

What sets Wisma Apollo apart from other accommodations in Kuala Kurun is not just the price. We understand that after a long day of field activities or government office meetings, what you truly need is a room that is truly comfortable for rest.

sections.heading: Wisma Apollo Hotel Facilities
paragraphs: Each room at Wisma Apollo is equipped with facilities typically found in star-rated hotels in big cities. The difference is, here the price is only IDR 200,000 per night.
In addition, every guest receives free mineral water, coffee, and tea every day. Clean towels and bathroom amenities are also provided.

sections.heading: Hotel Location in Kuala Kurun
paragraphs: Wisma Apollo is located at Jl. Letjen Soeprapto No.56, Kuala Kurun. Its position is very strategic — within walking distance to government offices, cafes, and culinary centers in Kuala Kurun.
